name: Bermaz Auto Berhad
summary: Bermaz Auto Berhad, an investment holding company, distributes and retails of completely built-up Mazda, Kia, and XPeng vehicles in Malaysia and the Philippines. It is also involved in distribution and retailing of completely knocked-down mazda and semi-knocked down Xpeng vehicles; provision of after-sales services; and distribution and sale of automotive spare parts through appointed dealers. The company was formerly known as Berjaya Auto Berhad and changed its name to Bermaz Auto Berhad in October 2016. Bermaz Auto Berhad was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Shah Alam, Malaysia.
